# Privacy and Security Requirements Quality Checklist: Contact Form and Message Retrieval

**Purpose**: Validate that the consent, data-minimisation, IP hashing, secrets, bearer-token scope, rate-limit, honeypot, retention, environment-separation and privacy-policy requirements are complete, clear, consistent and measurable
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [contracts/](../contracts/), [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation. This is a major change under Constitution Principle III.

## Consent and Data Minimisation

- [x] CHK001 Is the exact consent wording, or its required content, specified beyond "collected and used to reply"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK002 Is it stated whether consent is recorded with the message (timestamp or policy version), or explicitly excluded? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK003 Is the justification for each collected field documented against Principle VII's "only fields that are needed"? [Traceability, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK004 Is it stated whether the consent box is enforced server-side as well as in the form? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK005 Is the list of personal data that reaches third parties (Turnstile) specified consistently across the spec, plan and privacy policy? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK006 Are requirements defined for personal data in places other than D1 (request logs, error reports, Workers observability, browser storage)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016]

## Salted IP Hash

- [x] CHK007 Is "one-way salted fingerprint" defined precisely enough (algorithm class, salt secrecy, salt scope per environment)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK008 Is the salt's lifecycle specified (rotation, and what happens to existing hashes and rate-limit counts on rotation)? [Gap]
- [x] CHK009 Is it stated how the sender address is determined and what happens when it is missing or spoofable? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK010 Is the sole permitted use of the fingerprint (rate limiting) stated, and is it consistent with its retention for 12 months? [Consistency, Spec Key Entities, §FR-018]
- [x] CHK011 Is the exclusion of the fingerprint from retrieval output stated consistently in FR-020 and the retrieval contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020]

## Secrets Handling

- [x] CHK012 Is the complete inventory of secrets and build variables listed, with which are secret and which are public (for example the Turnstile site key)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-028]
- [x] CHK013 Are requirements defined for secret rotation and for revoking a compromised retrieval key? [Gap, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK014 Is the requirement that the setup check reveals no secret value measurable, including in error output and logs? [Measurability, Spec US9 scenario 3]
- [x] CHK015 Is the requirement that secrets never appear in client code, the repository, CI logs or chat stated for every secret, not only in the walkthrough? [Coverage, Spec US9 scenario 4]
- [x] CHK016 Are the permissions of any API token used by the setup check specified as least privilege? [Gap, Spec §FR-028]

## Bearer Token Scope and Retrieval

- [x] CHK017 Is "correct key" defined, including missing, malformed, empty and wrong-environment cases? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK018 Is "refused without revealing whether messages exist" specified as an identical response for every refusal reason? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK019 Is the scope "list-new and mark-read only" defined for every other method and path, including unknown paths and reading read messages by identifier? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK020 Is the response to marking a nonexistent or already-read message specified so it cannot leak content? [Clarity, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK021 Are brute-force limits defined for repeated wrong-key attempts on retrieval? [Gap, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK022 Is "a bounded number of requests" quantified (page size, maximum pages)? [Ambiguity, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK023 Is it stated whether mark-read can alter anything besides status (idempotence, no field edits)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK024 Is the exposure from a stolen key (unread personal data) acknowledged with any limiting requirement? [Gap, Spec Key Entities]

## Rate Limiting, Honeypot and Abuse

- [x] CHK025 Is the window defined as rolling or calendar-based for "any hour" and "any day"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK026 Is it defined whether rejected submissions (honeypot, failed check, invalid) count toward the limits? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK027 Is the shared-address consequence of per-fingerprint limits given an acceptance rationale? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [x] CHK028 Are the honeypot's silent-success behaviour and its interaction with rate limiting specified without contradicting FR-005's error rules? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK029 Is fail-open versus fail-closed behaviour defined when the human-check service or the rate-limit store is unavailable? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK030 Is "the site's own pages" defined for preview and production origins, and for requests with no origin header? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK031 Are requirements for markup in stored fields (plain text, never executed) stated for every consumer, including the assistant that reads them? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK032 Is protection of the retrieval endpoints against browser-origin access specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-022]

## Retention and Deletion

- [x] CHK033 Is "12 months" defined precisely (calendar months, boundary inclusion, time zone)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK034 Is behaviour specified when the scheduled clean-up fails or is missed, including a maximum tolerated delay? [Gap, Spec US7]
- [x] CHK035 Are time bounds for a manual deletion request (response time, scope including backups) defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK036 Is the retention period consistent across FR-018, the privacy policy text and the configurable default? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK037 Is it stated who can change the retention period and whether the policy must change with it? [Gap, Spec §FR-018]

## Environment Separation

- [x] CHK038 Is separation of preview and production defined for storage, keys, salts and the human-check secret, not only for messages? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, §FR-024]
- [x] CHK039 Is it specified how messages that real visitors send to a preview deployment are treated? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK040 Is the retention requirement stated for the preview store as well as production? [Gap, Spec §FR-018]

## Privacy Policy Accuracy

- [x] CHK041 Is each policy fact (fields, purpose, provider, region, retention, Turnstile data, deletion route) traceable to a single source of truth to prevent drift? [Traceability, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK042 Does the policy requirement cover the sender fingerprint and its purpose as collected data? [Gap, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK043 Does the policy requirement state that the region is Western North America rather than Canada, consistent with the clarification? [Consistency, Spec Clarifications, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK044 Is the policy update required to be in place before the form goes live? [Gap, Spec US6]
- [x] CHK045 Is the legal framework the policy must satisfy (for example PIPEDA) identified, or explicitly out of scope? [Assumption, Spec US6]
